share.title: Share a link
share.withPassword: Anyone with the link and the password
share.read: Include what {name} read: the files you added and what searches found
share.keep: Keep it up to date with each new answer
share.goes: The link holds the requests, the answers and the files {name} made. Your notes, memory and keys stay here.
share.made: Anyone with this link can open it until {date}.
share.madePassword: Anyone with this link and the password can open it until {date}. Send the password another way than the link.
share.code: The link as a QR code, to open it with a phone’s camera
share.tooBig: This is too big to share: a link holds 10 MB at most.
share.failed: The link couldn’t be made. Check your connection and try again.
share.notHere: This link was made on another device: only that one can change it.
share.updated: The link shows what is here now.
share.confirmStop: Stop sharing? Whoever has the link won’t be able to open it any more.
share.ended: This link stopped opening on {date}. Update it to open it again.
share.bring: Bring this shared task into {name}? It becomes one of your tasks, which you can continue.
share.broughtWith: The shared task is here. Added to your skills, to show all of it: {skills}.
share.cantOpen: This shared task couldn’t be opened.
share.reportWhat: What is wrong with what was shared?
share.reportLink: Send the whole link, so it can be seen
share.reportSent: Thank you. Your report was sent.
share.broken: This link isn’t whole. Ask whoever sent it for it again.
share.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again in an hour.
share.unreachable: This couldn’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
share.certified: Its answers’ certificates go with it. They carry this device’s seal, so your shares can be told apart and linked.

share.sealed.one: {count} answer is sealed by the device that wrote it, unchanged since.
share.sealed.other: {count} answers are sealed by the device that wrote them, unchanged since.

share.unsealed: A certificate doesn’t match what is shown here.
share.seal: The seal of the device that wrote it
